title: In-product "Try a Query" playground with live cost preview and persona snippets
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a small, contextual playground inside the Redwood Console that lets new users run a sample generation/query with three persona-tailored prompt snippets and a live per-run cost preview. The goal is to reduce first-session friction by showing how the API/console maps to results and dollars, while teaching quick configuration knobs (model selection, temperature, length) with inline tips.
user_stories: As a new engineer, I want to run a canonical example in the Console so I can validate the model without leaving the UI
As a product evaluator, I want to see the estimated cost of a sample run before I execute it, so I can understand pricing implications
As a developer onboarding a teammate, I want persona-ready prompt snippets (support agent, summarizer, code assistant) so I can start from a sensible default
goals: Increase first-session successful run rate by 20% for new signups
Improve conversion to API key usage (calls made within 24h) by providing a low-friction playground
Surface cost transparency: show per-request and per-token estimates inline
acceptance_criteria: Playground card rendered on first Console visit for accounts with < 3 total API calls
Three persona snippet tabs available: Support Agent, Document Summarizer, Code Assistant
Live cost estimation updates when model, tokens, or temperature changes (mocked pricing v1)
Execute run uses the same network call path as the Console's model route (no separate infra) and logs events for analytics
Accessibility: keyboard navigable, screen-reader labels for controls, color contrast meets AA
Instrumentation: events tracked (playground_shown, snippet_selected, run_executed, cost_preview_shown) and dashboard tile created
wireframes_notes: Top-level card shows 3-state flow: (1) intro + CTA, (2) configured snippet with live cost preview, (3) results output with copy/start-over
Cost preview line shows estimated tokens x price + conservative buffer and a tooltip explaining variance
Model selector defaults to recommended curated model; advanced dropdown exposes quantization/variant info
A subtle 'Save as template' control surfaces after a successful run for users to add to their project templates
constraints_and_tradeoffs: Live token estimation will be approximate for now; precise billing uses backend metrics—copy must clarify approximation
We will mock price tiers for public prototype; final prices require billing integration + feature gate for private deployments
To avoid adding runtime load we call the same inference endpoint but rate-limit playground runs and group events to avoid skewing production metrics
dependencies: ENG-34821 (analytics event schema for in-product playground)
PM-402 (pricing mock values and copy approval)
DES-523000 (translations for strings in onboarding flows)
risks: Misleading cost estimates could harm trust; mitigated with clear explanatory copy and 'Learn more' link
Playground runs might be abused for free usage; will add quota and monitor patterns during beta
Adding visible cost could increase hesitation—need to test phrasing and visual weight in usability sessions
metrics: first_run_rate (percent of new accounts that execute the playground within their first session)
playground_to_api_conversion (percent of playground users who generate API calls within 7 days)
cost_preview_engagement_rate (percent of users who view the cost tooltip before running)
accessibility: All interactive controls must have accessible names and focus states
Results pane should be ARIA-live polite for streaming output
Color choices must meet WCAG AA for foreground/background pairs
